title: Mira Bella House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Discover the ultimate coastal retreat at this stunning four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom beach house in Inlet Beach. Designed with both luxury and comfort in mind, this pet-friendly haven boasts an open living area, a chef's kitchen with quartz countertops and a farm sink, and beautifully appointed coastal interiors. Enjoy the serene outdoors with a spacious front porch featuring rocking chairs, a screened porch, and a back patio perfect for entertaining with an outdoor grill. Just a short ride from the beach, this home offers easy access to the vibrant 30 Avenue shopping and dining scene, Rosemary Beach, and countless other attractions. Indulge in the community amenities at The Preserve at Inlet Beach, including a refreshing pool with a pavilion and outdoor fireplace, nature trails, and direct access to Lake Powell for paddleboarding and kayaking adventures. The house features two-bedroom suites with en suite bathrooms, a bunk room, and a flex living area upstairs with a sleeper sofa. With modern conveniences like high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TVs in every room, and provided beach gear, this beach house promises a memorable and luxurious stay for families and friends alike. Embrace the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure in this exquisite coastal sanctuary.
